title: Hathni Mata Waterfall - Nature’s Hidden Gem near Vadodara
content:
Hathni Mata Waterfall, Vadodara

Nestled in the lush green hills of Jambughoda, around 80 km from Vadodara, Hathni Mata Waterfall is one of Gujarat’s most enchanting natural attractions. Surrounded by dense forests and rocky cliffs, this 100-meter-high waterfall offers a breathtaking escape into nature’s lap. The name “Hathni Mata” comes from a local legend about a goddess (Mata) whose stone idol resembles an elephant (“Hathni” in Gujarati).

The gushing waterfall, combined with the serene atmosphere and scenic beauty, makes it a perfect weekend getaway for families, nature lovers, and photographers alike. During the monsoon season, the waterfall comes alive with a spectacular flow, turning the whole area into a misty paradise.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Hathni Mata Waterfall is from July to September, during the monsoon, when the waterfall is at its most powerful and the surrounding greenery is lush and vibrant.

How to Reach

  • By Road: Hathni Mata Waterfall is about 80 km from Vadodara and can be reached via Pavagadh Road or through Jambughoda Wildlife Sanctuary.
  • By Train: The nearest railway station is Vadodara Junction.
  • By Air: Vadodara Airport is the closest, about 75 km away.

Things to Do

  • Enjoy scenic photography and nature walks.
  • Explore the small temple dedicated to Hathni Mata near the base of the waterfall.
  • Pack a picnic and relax with your family amidst nature.
  • Visit nearby attractions like Jambughoda Wildlife Sanctuary and Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park.

Travel Tips

  • Wear comfortable shoes; the path near the waterfall can be slippery.
  • Avoid visiting during heavy rains, as the water flow can be strong.
  • Carry drinking water and light snacks, as there are limited facilities nearby.

faqs.question: Where is Hathni Mata Waterfall located?
faqs.answer: Hathni Mata Waterfall is located near Jambughoda village, around 80 km from Vadodara in Gujarat.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Hathni Mata Waterfall?
faqs.answer: The ideal time to visit is during the monsoon season (July–September) when the waterfall is in full flow and the surroundings are lush green.

faqs.question: Is it safe to visit Hathni Mata Waterfall during heavy rains?
faqs.answer: It’s not advisable to visit during very heavy rains, as the water current becomes strong and the rocks are slippery.

faqs.question: Are there any entry fees for Hathni Mata Waterfall?
faqs.answer: No, there is no entry fee to visit the waterfall. However, parking charges may apply.

faqs.question: What are the nearby attractions?
faqs.answer: Nearby places include Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park, Jambughoda Wildlife Sanctuary, and Ajwa Water Park.
